proof_groups.proof_strategy: Prove the two general return witnesses by selecting their first generated disjunct, destructing nodes_general, unfolding xizi_dllseg in the impossible branch, and folding with xizi_dll_close or xizi_dll_empty_rev in the feasible branch. Then prove the derived nil_case witness with nodes_general := nil, resource cancellation, sepcon adjunction, and elimination of the impossible nonempty general-result branch.
proof_groups.natural_language_proof_strategy: The implementation only tests whether the first node equals the sentinel. xizi_dllseg makes this comparison equivalent to nodes_general being nil: an empty segment starts at its stop, while a nonempty segment carries a head-not-stop guard. The nil-only contract then follows by specializing the general result at nil and preserving the same xizi_dll resource through the wand.
proof_groups.grouping_reason: A single group is permitted for three targets and is preferred because these are same-function, same-predicate obligations with no helper dependency; the wand derivation is short and consumes the result of the same nil-case reasoning.

per_witness_plan.proof_of_xizi_double_link_empty_rec_retu: Select left; destruct nodes_general; nil contradicts first <> linklist_pre after dllseg simplification; cons folds with xizi_dll_close and proves non-nil by discrimination.
Select left; destruct nodes_general; nil supplies endpoint equalities and folds with xizi_dll_empty_rev; cons contradicts the dllseg head-not-stop guard and first = linklist_pre.
per_witness_plan.proof_of_xizi_double_link_empty_rec_deri: Instantiate nodes_general=nil, select the preserved nil resource, cancel it against the outer sepcon, apply wand adjunction, eliminate the nil<>nil general branch, and construct retval=1 from the feasible branch.

premise_discharge.non_null_head: Generated PreH2 in both return witnesses; the derived witness does not need to unfold/fold the list.
